timeline.cite: [I-M] the archive's own reading. NO ANNAL DATES THIS GRANT. 410 is a date TYPED IN THE MARGIN of a Later Quenta typescript, reported by Christopher Tolkien: HoME XI, commentary on LQ §31 — 'The date of this gift, as typed in the margin, was 410'. It is not an annal entry: the Grey Annals have no year 410 at all (…402, 413…) and Ladros occurs 0 times in the Grey Annals, 0 in AB 2 and 0 in AB 1. Silm 17 narrates it and dates nothing. TWO FURTHER CAUTIONS: the margin was typed against the AS-TYPED reading naming BREGOR son of Boromir, and Christopher carries 410 across to the emended Boromir; and 'BY THE SONS OF FINARFIN' HAS NO WITNESS — WJ §31 is passive and names no giver, and every glossary the corpus holds says 'the Noldorin Kings'
